import Mathlib

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology

theorem riemannLebesgue_fourierCoefficients_tendsto_zero
    {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable f volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℤ =>
        ‖((1 / (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)) *
          ∫ x in -Real.pi..Real.pi, f x * Complex.exp (-((n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖)
      (Filter.comap Int.natAbs Filter.atTop)
      (nhds 0) := by
  -- Strategy: extend f by 0 to ℝ, get integrable g, then use Riemann-Lebesgue on ℝ
  set g : ℝ → ℂ := (Set.uIoc (-Real.pi) Real.pi).indicator f with hg_def
  have hpi : (-Real.pi : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hg_int : Integrable g volume := by
    rw [hg_def]
    exact (hf.def').integrable_indicator measurableSet_uIoc
  -- Show integral on [-π,π] equals integral over ℝ of g times exponential
  have heq : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (∫ x in -Real.pi..Real.pi, f x * Complex.exp (-((n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I))) =
      ∫ x, g x * Complex.exp (-((n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    intro n
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hpi, hg_def]
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
    congr 1
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi
    · have hxu : x ∈ Set.uIoc (-Real.pi) Real.pi := by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hpi]; exact hx
      simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_mem hxu]
    · have hxu : x ∉ Set.uIoc (-Real.pi) Real.pi := by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hpi]; exact hx
      simp [Set.indicator_of_not_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_not_mem hxu]
  -- Reduce to showing the inner integral tends to 0

    exact (hf.mono_set (by rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hpi])).1.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Ioc
